data.narrative:
Callosum is an AI & Software company founded by Danyal Akarca and Jascha Achterberg. The analysis draws from a comp universe of 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. The target's stage, current valuation, and capital raised remain undisclosed.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to Callosum. The AI & Software sector contains 12 same-sector comparables, but filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yields fewer than three datapoints in each category—below the minimum threshold required for reliable median analysis. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce substantial distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, maturity, and revenue profiles across the broader AI & Software space. No triangulated valuation range can be responsibly derived from the available data.

The fundamental constraint is insufficient precision in stage, prior fundraising, and financial metrics for Callosum relative to its peer set. A defensible valuation narrative would require either: narrower stage and business-model alignment with at least three comparable private companies; disclosed financial metrics enabling revenue multiple or ARR-based analysis; or a narrower subset of disclosed prior rounds. Until such data is available, quantitative valuation synthesis remains premature.
